original_question: give me a report of the performance of the cranes per terminal

messages.content: give me a report of the performance of the cranes per terminal

**Crane performance report — North and South Terminals, 1 September–31 October 2026.** Moves/hour is calculated as total completed moves ÷ total operating hours for the period, not as an average of daily rates. Activity covers both complete calendar months shown in the history. The report includes the four cranes in the supplied activity data.
From 1 September through 31 October 2026, each of the four cranes recorded 183 idle hours and 122 downtime hours.
Only supported findings are shown.
